note: Both sets contain many vague, unbound claims (e.g., "component | height | 2\"") and repeat values, but Set A binds more values correctly: the drawing scale (1 1/2" = 1'-0"), the L3X3X1/4 angle profile to the PV structural members, the 2'-3 7/8" and 3'-1 5/16" segment lengths, 12'-3 3/4" and 7'-0" overall dimensions, and the C1/S-301 reference. Set B invents bindings such as "web thickness 5/8\"" (the members are L3x3x1/4 angles), "base block spacing" for 4 3/4" and 4 13/16", and misreads a dimension as "4 13", plus it duplicates 6 13/16" and 1'-11 1/8" under conflicting attributes. Set B does capture the 10'-3 3/4" total length of Module B and the 2'-11 7/8" right segment of Module A, which Set A misses, but overall Set A has fewer misbound and invented claims.
